ops.body: - [loop] With no place in front while a walk is minimized (an older walk's replay or a day, `fullScreenModal` over the tabs; the launch cover over the walk screen as a reload opens), a Remind me here fired goes to a notification, which the web does not show with the page in front (`transport.web.ts`, `show` returns false while visible), and is marked fired all the same (a "once" flag cleared): never seen. The likely shape: `createRecallPlaces` keeps a fire no place took, with the page in front, for the next place in front, as `handOn` does for the bar (`discovery/recallCheck.ts` `deliver`); keeping a fire unmarked until it is shown would change when a reminder counts as fired, which is the owner's (found by `/tend explore`, Nov 17, and confirmed by the review of `tend explore 21-23`; medium)

- [owner] A reminder the recording bar held out of sight for minutes (under the area card, a viewer) still says "Two memories here" once seen, though the walker may be hundreds of metres on: the walk screen's card goes after 100 m (`REMINDER_AWAY_M`), the bar keeps no place. Keep the fire's place and change the words past 100 m ("back there"), or leave it; dropping it would lose it unseen again, and the words are the owner's (`RecordingBar.tsx`; the review of `tend explore 22`, F6, low)

argv: A tapped reminder on the bar
ops.body: - Not fixed in `/tend explore` (Nov 17): the clean fix (write the key only when `showWalk()` goes ahead, through `openRecall`, which tells a walk screen mounting meanwhile) removes the bar's only `db` import, which leaves its `no-restricted-syntax` count in `eslint-suppressions.json` stale, and a baseline is not the loop's to prune (`scripts/tend.js` FORBIDDEN): the owner's, or a `/fix`.

- [ ] **Do:** since `tend explore 21-23` and their review (Nov 17), set Remind me here ("Once") on two moments at one spot. On a later walk, minimize it, open an area's card on Explore (the tabs fold), pass the spot, then tap the card's Walk to; again with Explore's search keyboard up as you pass; again under a moment's viewer, closed by Android Back; again locking the phone a second after the bar shows the line; again after a force-quit and relaunch with the walk open, minimized at once. **Expect:** under the card nothing shows, and Walk to brings the walk screen up with its card "Two memories here" (`handOnRecall`); under the keyboard or the viewer the bar's line waits and shows once they go, then stays its half-minute (`barInSight`, `modalsUp`); locked, the line is there on return with what was left of its half-minute (`reminderSight`); after the relaunch the line is on the bar, never on the walk screen kept behind the tabs (`useNavigation().isFocused()` on the native stack). (R7, NV8)

**Nov 17, `/tend explore --deploy=main`, the reminders a person never saw** (opened from `f293e9db`, rebased on `84b47e2a`; no sweep, lenses 1-7 not run; aimed at DEFERRED's reminder items, mediums first; the faster lane of decision 0181).
- The rule both mediums broke: a fire is marked fired (a "once" flag cleared) as it is delivered, so it must never go where no person can see it. `docs/research/adjacent-apps.md` records no location reminder; the shape follows the phones' own (a notification that arrives while the person is busy waits in the Notification Center or the shade until it is seen; from memory, not yet recorded).
- `tend explore 21`: every place listens and says whether it is in front (`firePlace`): after a reload, the walk screen kept behind the tabs no longer takes a fire out of sight; the memories journey checks the bar has it every time.
- `tend explore 22`: the recording bar holds a fire while it is out of sight (folded under a full-screen card, a Modal up: `modalsUp`), its half-minute counted from when it is seen (`reminderSight`).
- `tend explore 23`: the note's reminder card names itself with one full stop ("… cardamom. Open", `reminderName`).
- The review (one round, the `auditor`; one high, two medium, four low; five accepted, one deferred, none rejected, and the rule lines): `tend explore audit 23` (high: a bar that goes with a fire seen for under 2 s hands it on to the next place in front of the walk, so Walk to from the area card shows it on the walk screen's card; `createRecallPlaces`), `audit 24` (the keyboard counts as out of sight), `audit 26` (the walk screen asks its navigator at fire time), `audit 27` (the app behind is out of sight; the half-minute is time in sight) in one commit; `audit 25` (`holdModal` tested, a step under a viewer) in another. F6 filed `[owner]` low (the bar's "here" once the walker has moved on). Lines added to `explore-marks.md` and `tabs-and-home.md`.
- Filed: `[loop]` medium, a fire with no place in front (a replay or day over the tabs, the launch cover) goes to a web notification that does not show; `[owner]` low, F6; a note on the `RECALL_OPEN_KEY` low (its fix needs a lint baseline pruned, not the loop's); a native check under Notifications. The three items built left DEFERRED.
- Journeys on the final export: `memories` (its reminder steps: 21, 22, 23, audits 23 and 25), `walk`, `launch`; typecheck, lint, `npm test`. Not run: the sweep's lenses and the balance's evolve. Nothing here has run on a phone: the listeners, the Modal count, the keyboard and AppState reads are native code too.
